info.title: ERP-AI-Pro API
info.description: Modular ERP for Dewiride. Routes are grouped as /api/<domain>/<module>/<resource>, every response carries an X-Correlation-ID header and every error is an RFC 9457 problem document.

get.summary: Starts the Microsoft Entra sign-in and returns to the local path afterwards; a signed-in caller goes straight to that path.

parameters.name: returnUrl
parameters.description: Local path of the page to open once signed in, such as /platform/attachments; the home page when omitted.

post.summary: Ends the session, when the request carries one, and redirects to the Microsoft Entra end-session endpoint, which returns to the sign-in page.

get.summary: Issues the signed-in person's antiforgery tokens again: the request token in the readable cookie __Host-erp-xsrf, sent back in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header of every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.
Returns the signed-in person: their Microsoft Entra ID object id, display name, sign-in name and app roles, and the permissions their roles give them.
Returns when the session ends unless a request renews it and when it ends at the latest, without renewing it.

post.summary: Renews the session at once, for the idle timeout from now within the session lifetime, and returns when it ends.

get.summary: Returns the application name, version and uptime of the API.
Lists the most recent starts of the API, newest first.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: How many starts to return, between 1 and 100; 20 when the caller does not ask.

get.summary: Lists stored attachments, newest first unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Stores one file sent as a multipart/form-data part with a file name.

requestBody.description: The file, as the single part of a multipart/form-data body that carries a file name.

get.summary: Describes the largest file and the media types an upload may have.
Describes one stored attachment.

delete.summary: Deletes an attachment; its download links stop working.

post.summary: Creates a short-lived link that downloads the attachment for the person asking.

get.summary: Streams the original file for a valid, unexpired link of the person asking.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Token of a download link created for this attachment by the person downloading it.

get.summary: Lists the recorded changes, newest first unless the caller sorts them, with the names their actors, records and references have today.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

get.summary: Streams the recorded changes the filter selects as a CSV file, oldest first, with one line per changed value.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the list of changes allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |. Absent, every change is exported.

get.summary: Lists the jobs the ERP runs on its own, by name, with the schedule, the next occurrence and the latest run of each recurring job.
Lists the runs of the jobs, newest first unless the caller sorts them, with the name each person who asked for one has today.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

get.summary: Describes one job run with every step of its history, oldest first: its attempts and their outcomes, and who re-ran or cancelled it.

post.summary: Puts a run that failed, gave up or was cancelled back to run again at once, with its failures counted from zero.
Cancels a run that waits to start or to try again, or asks a running run to stop, which its runner sees at its next lease renewal; asking a running run again changes nothing.

get.summary: Lists the people of the ERP, by display name unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter

post.summary: Registers a person by work email before their first sign-in, which links the record to their Entra account.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one person.

put.summary: Changes the employee code, phone number and date of joining of a person.

delete.summary: Deletes a person's record; their sessions end at their next request.

put.summary: Deactivates or reactivates a person; a deactivated person cannot sign in, their sessions end at their next request, and their team reports from today to the manager the deactivation names.
Replaces the roles a person holds in the ERP, Finance, HR and Manager; their next request holds the new ones.

get.summary: Searches the company directory in Microsoft Entra on the administrator's behalf and names the people the ERP already holds.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to look for at the start of a word of a person's display name, or at the start of their email address or user principal name: at most 100 characters, at least 2 of them besides spaces at either end, without & or control characters.

post.summary: Registers a person of the company directory by their Entra object id, with the name and sign-in name the directory holds, so their first sign-in finds the record.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

post.summary: Reads the Entra accounts of the active people with the ERP's own permission and deactivates everyone whose account is disabled or deleted; their sessions end at their next request.

get.summary: Lists the people whose position names a person as their manager today or from a later date, the team a deactivation of that person hands over, by display name.
Lists the active people who have joined by a date, with the department, designation and manager of the position each holds on it, today unless the caller names another.

parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Date whose chart to read, in India; absent reads today's. Another date than today needs the permission identity.users.positions.read.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

get.summary: Lists every permission of the ERP in ordinal order, with what it lets a holder do and the built-in roles that hold it.
Describes the signed-in person's own record: their details, today's position, the built-in roles they hold and the colour theme they chose.
Returns the signed-in person's photo from the company directory in Microsoft Entra, read on their behalf, or no content when the directory holds none.

put.summary: Saves the colour theme the signed-in person chose, which the web app applies in every browser they sign in from, and answers the choice the account then holds.

get.summary: Lists the departments, by name unless the caller sorts them; each names the department it sits under.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Creates a department at the top of the tree or under another.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one department.

put.summary: Renames a department, or moves it under another department or to the top of the tree.

delete.summary: Deletes a department that has no departments within it and that no position names today or from a later date.

get.summary: Lists the designations, by name unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Adds a designation to the list positions choose from.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one designation.

delete.summary: Deletes a designation that no position names today or from a later date.

get.summary: Lists a person's positions, the latest first unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Records a person's position from a date, in the past or the future, until their next position starts.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one of a person's positions.

delete.summary: Withdraws one of a person's positions; the one before it then holds until the next starts.

get.summary: Lists every country the ERP knows by name, with its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
Lists India's States and Union Territories with their GST State codes, those of one date or every code with its dates.

parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Date whose State codes are wanted, as yyyy-MM-dd; absent lists every code with the dates it applies to.

get.summary: Lists every currency an amount in the ERP can be in, by code, with its name and decimal places.
Lists the financial years from one to another, each with its quarters and its twelve monthly periods from April.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First financial year to list, by its label such as 2024-25.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last financial year to list, by its label such as 2027-28; at most 49 years after the first.

get.summary: Lists the exchange rates, the newest day first unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Records the rupee value of a foreign currency for one day.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one exchange rate.

put.summary: Corrects the rate, unit and source of an exchange rate.

delete.summary: Removes an exchange rate recorded by mistake; its currency and day can then be recorded again.

post.summary: Records the rates of a file all together, leaving alone those already recorded with the same rate, or none of them when a rate cannot be recorded.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Lists the statutory parameter sets by title, each with the version in force today in India and the next one.
Describes one statutory parameter set: its columns, its versions with what each changed, and the entries and changes of the version in force on a date.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key of the set, such as gst.central-tax-rates: two or more dot-separated parts of lower-case words joined by hyphens.

parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Date whose version to show, as yyyy-MM-dd; absent shows the version in force today in India.

get.summary: Lists the kinds of document the ERP numbers, by title, each with the rule its numbers follow this financial year and its numbering once it is set up.
Describes one numbering with the kind of document it numbers and the financial years it has opened.

put.summary: Changes a numbering: the current financial year takes the new format and next number while it has given no number, and otherwise the format applies from the next year.

post.summary: Sets up the numbering of a kind of document, opening the current financial year at its next number.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Lists the approval requests of one box: those that wait for the caller's decision, late first; those the caller asked for or submitted; those with a step the caller decided; or every request, for a caller who may see them all.

parameters.name: box
parameters.description: Which requests to list: waiting, those that wait for your decision, late first, when absent; mine, those you asked for or submitted; decided, those with a step you decided; all, every request, which needs the permission platform.approvals.requests.read-all.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

get.summary: Counts the requests that wait for the caller's decision, how many of them are late, and how many the caller asked for or submitted still wait.
Describes one approval request with its steps, the earlier requests of its record and what the caller may do with it; a request the caller may not see answers as an unknown one.

post.summary: Approves the step a request waits at: its next step starts waiting, or at the last step the request is approved together with the change its module makes to the record.
Sends a request back with what needs to change, closing it together with the change its module makes to the record.
Rejects a request with the reason why, closing it together with the change its module makes to the record.
Withdraws a request that still waits, as the person it is for or the person who submitted it, closing it together with the change its module makes to the record.

get.summary: Lists the kinds of request the ERP asks approval for, by title, each with its steps, the working days it declares and the administrators' setting once one is set up.

post.summary: Sets up whether a kind of request needs approval and how many working days each of its steps has, for the requests submitted from then on.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

put.summary: Changes whether a kind of request needs approval and how many working days each of its steps has, for the requests submitted from then on; a request already waiting keeps its route and its due times.

get.summary: Returns every feature flag of the catalog with its evaluated state.

version.description: Version of the request the decision was made from, as the API last returned it.

comment.description: What needs to change, to send the request back, or why it is rejected, to reject it, both of which need one; a note to approve it, which needs none. At most 1,000 characters, kept without the spaces at either end; a blank one is none.

version.description: Version of the request the withdrawal was made from, as the API last returned it.

comment.description: Why the request is withdrawn; optional, at most 1,000 characters, kept without the spaces at either end.

roles.description: Roles the person holds in the ERP from now on, in place of those they held; their app roles in Microsoft Entra give them Administrator and Employee besides.

version.description: Version of the record the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

required.description: Whether the kind's records need approval from now on; false lets each go through at once, without a request, so nobody but the person who made it looks at it.

workingDaysToDecide.description: Working days each step of the requests submitted from now on has, from 1 to 30; a request already waiting keeps its due times.

version.description: Version of the setting the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

format.description: How the numbers look: from the current financial year while it has given no number, otherwise from the next.

nextNumber.description: Running number the current financial year starts at, which changes only while the year has given no number; absent to keep it.

version.description: Version of the numbering the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

status.description: Status the record takes: a deactivated person cannot sign in, and their open sessions end at their next request.

version.description: Version of the record the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

team.description: Who the person's team reports to from today, given with a deactivation only: the team is everyone whose position names the person as manager today or from a later date, and deactivating a person with a team needs it. Giving it also needs the permissions identity.users.positions.record and identity.users.positions.withdraw.

theme.description: Colour theme the signed-in person chose for the web app: system follows the theme of their device.

rate.description: Rupees for the unit of the currency, more than 0 and at most 1,000,000, with at most four decimal places.

unit.description: Units of the currency the rate is for: 1, 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000 or 100,000, as the source quotes it.

source.description: Where the rate comes from, such as FBIL reference rate; absent or blank when not given.

version.description: Version of the rate the correction was made from, as the API last returned it.

name.description: Name of the department, unique among the departments under the same parent.

parentId.description: Department it sits under; absent places it at the top of the tree.

name.description: Name of the designation, unique among the designations.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; the type member is this code under /problems/.

traceId.description: Correlation id of the request, the same value the X-Correlation-ID response header carries.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the foreign currency, such as USD; never INR.

rateDate.description: Day the rate is for, today or earlier by India's time.

rate.description: Rupees for the unit of the currency, more than 0 and at most 1,000,000, with at most four decimal places.

unit.description: Units of the currency the rate is for: 1, 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000 or 100,000, as the source quotes it.

source.description: Where the rate comes from, such as FBIL reference rate; absent or blank when not given.

rates.description: The rates of the file, in its order, at most 1,000; recorded all together or not at all.

entraObjectId.description: Entra object id of the person in the company directory, as the directory search returned it.

employeeCode.description: Employee code: letters, digits, hyphens, slashes and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit, unique among the people of the ERP.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number: an international number starting with + and its country code, or a 10-digit Indian mobile number.

dateOfJoining.description: Date the person joined the company.

roles.description: Roles the person holds in the ERP besides Administrator and Employee, which come from their app roles in Microsoft Entra; naming any needs the permission identity.users.people.assign-roles.

prefix.description: Fixed text every number begins with: capital letters, digits and the special characters the rule allows, such as INV/; empty for none.

year.description: How the financial year follows the fixed text: none, full (2026-27) or abbreviated (26-27).

separator.description: Character between the financial year and the running number, such as /; empty for none, and empty when the year is not shown.

digits.description: Fewest digits of the running number, which zeros fill in front, from 1 to 18.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; the type member is this code under /problems/.

traceId.description: Correlation id of the request, the same value the X-Correlation-ID response header carries.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the foreign currency, such as USD; never INR.

rateDate.description: Day the rate is for, today or earlier by India's time.

rate.description: Rupees for the unit of the currency, more than 0 and at most 1,000,000, with at most four decimal places.

unit.description: Units of the currency the rate is for: 1, 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000 or 100,000, as the source quotes it.

source.description: Where the rate comes from, such as FBIL reference rate; absent or blank when not given.

effectiveFrom.description: Date the position starts, in the past or the future; it holds until the date the person's next position starts.

departmentId.description: Department the person is in from that date; absent puts them in none.

designationId.description: Designation the person holds from that date; absent gives them none.

managerId.description: Person they report to from that date, never themself; absent gives them no manager.

displayName.description: Name the ERP shows for the person until their first sign-in brings the one Entra keeps.

workEmail.description: Work email of the person, which their first sign-in matches to link the record to their Entra account.

employeeCode.description: Employee code: letters, digits, hyphens, slashes and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit, unique among the people of the ERP.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number: an international number starting with + and its country code, or a 10-digit Indian mobile number.

dateOfJoining.description: Date the person joined the company.

roles.description: Roles the person holds in the ERP besides Administrator and Employee, which come from their app roles in Microsoft Entra; naming any needs the permission identity.users.people.assign-roles.

kind.description: Key of the kind of request, as the list of kinds gives it.

required.description: Whether the kind's records need approval; false lets each go through at once, without a request, so nobody but the person who made it looks at it.

workingDaysToDecide.description: Working days each step of the kind's requests has, from 1 to 30.

documentType.description: Key of the kind of document to number, as the list of numbered documents gives it.

nextNumber.description: Running number the current financial year starts at, from 1 to the last the format can give: 1, or the number after the last one given outside the ERP this year.

managerId.description: Person the team reports to from today: an active person outside the team, never the person deactivated; null makes the team report to no one.

name.description: Name of the department, unique among the departments under the same parent.

parentId.description: Department it sits under from now on, never itself or one within it; absent moves it to the top of the tree.

version.description: Version of the department the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

name.description: Name of the designation, unique among the designations; every position that names it shows the new name.

version.description: Version of the designation the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

employeeCode.description: Employee code: letters, digits, hyphens, slashes and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit, unique among the people of the ERP; empty clears it.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number: an international number starting with + and its country code, or a 10-digit Indian mobile number; empty clears it.

dateOfJoining.description: Date the person joined the company; absent clears it.

version.description: Version of the record the edit was made from, as the API last returned it.

SessionCookie.description: The session cookie __Host-erp-session, HttpOnly and Secure, which the API sets once a Microsoft Entra ID sign-in started at /api/auth/login completes; a browser sends it on every request to this origin.
SessionCookie.name: __Host-erp-session

AntiforgeryToken.description: The value of the readable cookie __Host-erp-xsrf, required with the session cookie on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE it signs in, which otherwise answer 400 antiforgery.token-missing or antiforgery.token-invalid; GET /api/auth/antiforgery issues it again, and POST /api/auth/logout also takes it in the form field __RequestVerificationToken.
AntiforgeryToken.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
